# Filter for irregular galaxies and spiral galaxies
irregular_df = df[df['object type'] == 'irregular galaxy']

avg_irregular_mag = irregular_df['apparent magnitude'].mean()
avg_spiral_mag = spiral_df['apparent magnitude'].mean()

# Check if the difference is exactly 2.1
answer = (avg_irregular_mag - avg_spiral_mag) == 2.1
